messages:
maya (docs): quick flag 8 linkcheck on docusaurus failed for /sdk/js/overview. anchors in code examples aren't being generated the same as our links. repro locally with `yarn start` and visiting the anchor 
noah (devex): can you paste a minimal repro? is it a fenced code block or inline code that has backticks?
maya (docs): snippet in question: 
```
### JS client usage

Call: `client.generate({ model: 'gpt-small' })`
```
we link to `#js-client-usage` from another page but the emitted id is `js-client-usage-` (trailing dash) in the HTML — looks like docusaurus slugify treats inline code punctuation oddly
travis (eng): hmm, docusaurus uses github-slugger + some sanitization. trailing punctuation can cause extra '-' if sanitized token list empty? have you tried adding explicit heading id like `### JS client usage {#js-client-usage}`
maya (docs): yes, manual ids work but we can't add ids everywhere. would like a fix in the pipeline so authors don't have to remember. also this regressed after our MDX upgrade to v2.
noah (devex): two options: 1) normalize generated slugs in our prebuild step (post-mdx) to strip trailing hyphens, or 2) add a remark plugin to ensure code spans inside headings are slugified to plain text. i prefer plugin route
travis (eng): i'll prototype a remark-slug-normalizer. quick hack: in `docs/tools/slugfix.js` use `slugger.slug(text.replace(/[`‘’“”]/g, ''))` to drop quotes/backticks before slugging. want me to open a PR?
maya (docs): please do and include a changelog note. also add a small e2e: generate the site html and assert `document.querySelector('#js-client-usage')` exists
travis (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912. changes: remark plugin, unit test, docs on why. CI will run `yarn docs:build` in the PR workflow
ci-bot: docs build started for PR 912
ci-bot: docs build failed: 2 anchor mismatch warnings treated as errors in linkcheck step
maya (docs): what do the warnings show?
ci-bot: warning: link from /guides/sdk to /sdk/js/overview#js-client-usage not found; emitted id `js-client-usage-` in /sdk/js/overview.html (file attached)
travis (eng): ah, local build produced different slug because the remark plugin ran but slugger state persisted across headings producing trailing '-' for repeated normalized keys. fix: reset slugger per-file and dedupe properly. i'll push patch
noah (devex): also add a fallback rule in our link resolver: if target anchor not found, try stripped/trailing-dash variants before failing linkcheck. last resort only
travis (eng): pushed fix and added a small util `normalizeAnchorCandidates(anchor)` used by linkcheck. updated tests
ci-bot: docs build passed on branch (linkcheck ok)
maya (docs): LGTM. thanks! can we add a short note in docs authoring guide about avoiding inline-code-only headings while we have plugin rollout?
noah (devex): added a short paragraph in CONTRIBUTING.md and a sample heading pattern. will merge after maya approves
maya (docs): approved. merging now. thanks all :raised_hands:
